retrievalProfile.description: A centered monochrome portrait inset within a heavily textured, rusted metallic background featuring horizontal title blocks.
triggerTerms: sepia inset portrait with distressed edges

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, high-contrast monochrome photograph with rough, deckled edges is framed by a large expanse of mottled, rust-colored texture. Text is contained within two horizontal rectangular bars, one at the top and one at the bottom, which share the background's metallic sheen.
coreVisualRelationships: Central portrait as the primary focal point
Horizontal text bars anchoring the top and bottom
High-contrast black and white photo against warm earth-toned background
Rough, organic textures throughout all elements
coreInvariants: Heavily distressed, rusted iron texture background
Rough-cut or deckled border on the central image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-close portrait is centered, occupying approximately 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central photograph acts as the primary anchor, supported by the heavy top text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top text block, moves down to the central portrait, and finishes at the bottom subtitle bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The textured background serves as active negative space, providing a gritty atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Burnt orange and rust brown (background texture)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden ochre (text highlights and metallic sheen)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones contrasted with a desaturated, high-contrast central image.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses wide, all-caps serif with thin strokes
Secondary text uses a fluid, slanted cursive script
Subtitles use a clean, spaced-out small-caps serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Serifs are slightly elongated and sharpened
Cursive elements have variable line weight mimicking ink flow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a formal, wide serif and a casual, fluid script.

preserve: The use of a script for the first name
avoid: Clean, straight edges on the photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, small-serif aesthetic of the display text
Captures the fluid, handwritten feel of the script element

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a background with a heavy rusted iron texture in burnt orange and brown. Place a central square photograph of a man with a guitar in high-contrast black and white, featuring rough, torn paper edges. Add two horizontal bars with a similar metallic texture at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply wide-tracked serif typography in dark brown onto the top and bottom bars. Use a cursive script for the top-most word, overlapping the main display text slightly.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture sufficiently gritty and rusted?
Does the central photo have distressed, non-linear edges?
Is the typography contained within horizontal bars?
Is the color palette restricted to warm earth tones and monochrome?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distress on the photo edges
Width of the horizontal text bars

mustAchieve: Clear hierarchy between the portrait and text
avoid: Overly busy layouts that obscure the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rust texture does not look like a simple repeating pattern.
Verify the text is legible against the metallic bar background.
Check that the monochrome photo maintains high contrast without losing detail.
Confirm the deckled edge of the photo looks organic rather than computer-generated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W subject with a heavily textured industrial background, framed by structured typographic bars.
